card: This PR increases timeouts for event waits in test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py to prevent intermittent test failures on slow machines. In the existing test, event waits such as template6 waitNext use a short 1-second default timeout that races against test-triggered events. The author provides a reproduction patch and notes this addresses review feedback from recently merged PR 36791.
evidence: PR description quotes review feedback from ryanofsky on #36791 pointing out the race condition in the template6 waitNext call
PR description provides a minimal reproduction diff demonstrating test failure when sleep_time exceeds the 1-second timeout
problem: On slow test hosts, IPC mining tests can intermittently time out because event waits use a default 1-second timeout while waiting for events scheduled after preceding delays.

risk.why: A mistake only affects the functional test suite by causing false test failures or excessive test run times.

summary: Increases timeout limits for event-waiting calls in the IPC mining functional test. Specifically, it introduces a longer IPC timeout constant for waits that depend on events triggered asynchronously by the test framework.
